 Summary
 Quarter-final draw follows later
 Rogers penalty opens scoring for Chelsea but Liverpool's Gakpo levels from spot
 Man City squeeze past Brighton on penalties 
 Bournemouth hit three v Villa & Sunderland 3-2 winners v Brentford 
 Nketiah scores Palace winner at Fulham 
 Liverpool gambled on Jacquet and its paying off 
 Dowman sees red but did Arteta go too far? 
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Gary Rose, Jess Anderson and Charlotte Coates
 Most recent Most popular get involved Get Involved published at 22:24 GMT 22:24 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 It really shouldn't be that difficult to hit the target from 12 yards. Having a "bad" penalty saved is one thing, but missing the target altogether is criminal.
 Shuan 
 355 178 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Absolutely brilliant drama at the end' published at 22:23 GMT 22:23 GMT 
 FT: Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea (Liverpool win 6-5 on penalties) 
 Jobi McAnuff 
Former Crystal Palace winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Absolutely brilliant drama at the end. A combination of some really good penalties and some not so good penalties. The keepers pulling off saves as well, but again, the game was played in a really good spirit. 
 Two teams that faced it in exactly the way that you would want them to and really went all out to win the game.
 245 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 22:18 GMT 22:18 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Joe Gomez scoring the winning penalty. Come on.
 Lindsey 
 2249 333 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Brilliant entertainment!' published at 22:17 GMT 22:17 GMT 
 FT: Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea (Liverpool win 6-5 on penalties) 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Brilliant entertainment!
 You hate to see a team lose in a situation like that, but it's a disappointing penalty from Wesley Fofana.
 I didn't like the run up, and he clears it, he clears the crossbar by miles.
 A really enjoyable game.
 708 152 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22:15 GMT 22:15 GMT 
 FT: Liverpool 1-1 Chelsea (Liverpool win 6-5 on penalties) 
 Some very good penalties in there, but also some dreadful ones.
 Liverpool extend their penalty shoot-out record against Chelsea - winning all five they have had with them.
 1492 196 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 MISSED PENALTY - Liverpool 6-5 Chelsea published at 22:12 GMT 22:12 GMT 
 Wesley Fofana 
 Wesley Fofana sends it into the air and Liverpool are into the quarter-finals! 
 5863 1383 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 6-5 Chelsea published at 22:11 GMT 22:11 GMT 
 Joe Gomez 
 Well Joe Gomez has never scored for Liverpool in regulation time but what a penalty that is.
 Rifled into the top corner.
 7208 1780 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 MISSED PENALTY - Liverpool 5-5 Chelsea published at 22:10 GMT 22:10 GMT 
 Emanuel Emegha 
 The Kop roars as Giorgi Mamardashvili gets down to his right to make the save from a poor penalty.
 We go again...
 3600 1501 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 MISSED PENALTY - Liverpool 5-5 Chelsea published at 22:09 GMT 22:09 GMT 
 Ryan Gravenberch 
 A penalty shootout brimming with quality but that is a poor penalty from the midfielder.
 Chelsea could win it with their next spot kick...
 1713 2410 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 5-5 Chelsea published at 22:08 GMT 22:08 GMT 
 Levi Colwill 
 A short run up but not lacking in power and it's hammered into the roof of the net.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1616 2088 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 5-4 Chelsea published at 22:07 GMT 22:07 GMT 
 Bradley Barcola 
 Lovely penalty into the top corner from Liverpool's summer signing.
 On we go.
 2987 1157 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 4-4 Chelsea published at 22:07 GMT 22:07 GMT 
 Jordan Henderson 
 Boos from the Kop as Liverpool's former captain steps up and he makes no mistake.
 Straight and powerful.
 1803 2295 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 MISSED PENALTY - Liverpool 4-3 Chelsea published at 22:06 GMT 22:06 GMT 
 Konstantinos Tsimikas 
 Well Konstantinos Tsimikas was the hero when Liverpool beat Chelsea to win this trophy a couple of years ago but he blasts over the bar!
 Liverpool were ready to celebrate but they'll have to go again...
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1672 2353 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 MISSED PENALTY - Liverpool 4-3 Chelsea published at 22:05 GMT 22:05 GMT 
 Valentín Barco 
 Not a confident run up by Chelsea's summer signing and he slams it off the post!
 Image source, Getty Images 
 3119 1216 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 4-3 Chelsea published at 22:04 GMT 22:04 GMT 
 Florian Wirtz 
 Mike Penders goes the wrong way as Florian Wirtz fires into the bottom right corner.
 Some high-quality penalties so far - who will blink first?
 Image source, Getty Images 
 2584 958 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 3-3 Chelsea published at 22:03 GMT 22:03 GMT 
 Roméo Lavia 
 Easy as you like, slotted into the bottom corner as Giorgi Mamardashvili goes the other way.
 1021 1544 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 3-2 Chelsea published at 22:02 GMT 22:02 GMT 
 Cody Gakpo 
 Slammed into the back of the net, sending the keeper the wrong way.
 Two from two tonight for Cody Gakpo.
 2159 868 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Liverpool 2-2 Chelsea published at 22:01 GMT 22:01 GMT 
 Morgan Rogers 
 Squeezed into the bottom corner by Morgan Rogers, who had already scored on in normal time.
 Giorgi Mamardashvili went the right way but couldn't quite get there.

 GOAL - Liverpool 2-1 Chelsea published at 22:00 GMT 22:00 GMT

 Another confident penalty into the roof of the net!
 No saving any of these so far.

 Another brilliant penalty from Pedro Neto.
 Powerful and high into the net.
